notes.craft: Every sampled product page on the official shop states a country of make (mostly Japan, but knitwear made in China and one tailored jacket made in Vietnam) and nothing more: no factory, no mill. The company profile describes a planning and wholesale business with no owned production. Country only: a 2.

craft_evidence.owned_d: No owned factory, workshop or mill found. Company profile on the shop (Yohji Yamamoto Inc., Higashi-Shinagawa, Tokyo) describes the business as clothing/goods planning and wholesale/retail; the Japanese recruitment listing (Mynavi) says 企画、製造卸、販売 (planning, manufacturing-wholesale, sales) and names no factory. Corporate site yohjiyamamoto.co.jp has no production content. No parent group (independent; Integral Corporation investment not relevant to making).
craft_evidence.countries: Japan 5/8, China 2/8, Vietnam 1/8 (sample of 8 PDPs: Pour Homme raglan coat, denim painter pants, padded blouson, flannel cap all Japan; Y's-line serge cargo pants Japan; Pour Homme cashmere embroidered knit China; flocked crow knit pullover China; washer-wool gabardine belted jacket Vietnam). Note the house is not all-Japan-made.
